body:
## Summary

Adds the MVP requirements spec for the album ranker: one-person web app, SQLite, catalog search with covers, per-year ranking screen, head-to-head Elo ratings (single algorithm, seeded from the yearly ranks), artist and decade views, and a one-off spreadsheet import. The spec also records what the real `Best Albums.xlsx` formulas say, which differs from the ticket's description (752 rows, 81 listed-only rows, the year weight formula, two artist rollup rules).

Ticket: ALBUM-2 (https://github.com/dbeallor/album-ranker/issues/2)
Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-album-ranker-mvp.md`

Closes #2

## Changes

- New spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-album-ranker-mvp.md`. No code.

Context size: pass skipped (not collective-wisdom)

## Proof

- **Spec committed and approved**: spec is on this branch. The user approved it in the Chief of Staff thread ("approve 2") after the Elo revision at commit 3091b45.
  After that approval, code review fixes amended the spec (rules the approved version left undefined, no change of direction): replay tiebreaks, skipped matchups, decade list upkeep, import conflict and re-run rules, the rank-plus-honorable-mention row imported as an honorable mention without a review item, and listed albums showing no rating. The merge approval covers them.
- **Every Scope item has an answer or an open question**: users and shape (§ Users and shape), MVP features, scoring (§ Scoring: head-to-head Elo), decade top 25, albums versus releases, data model outline, non-goals, calls I made, and whole-MVP acceptance each have a section; unresolved items are in § Open questions for the user.

Not proven:
- Follow-up tickets #3 to #10 still match the spec: a ticket child may only change its own ticket, so the spec's § Follow-up tickets: changes needed lists the edits for the Chief of Staff or the user to apply.

## Code review (pass 1)

Head: f7798a1. Docs-only diff, one spec. Arithmetic checked: row kinds sum to 752, years to 56, Elo 1516/1484, tie unchanged, artist example 1600, matchup scale about 3,355.

**Must fix**
1. Acceptance 4 says a matchup changes "the artist and decade lists". It conflicts with acceptance 2 (a 1500 vs 1500 tie changes nothing) and with hand-ranked decade lists, which ratings never change.

**Should fix**
2. Replay order for a ranked album against the year's honorable mentions is undefined, so ratings and the "replay twice" test are unstable. Name a tiebreak (album id) and one for explicit matchups (created at, then id).
3. A skipped pair is served again right away. Exclude skipped pairs for the session.
4. Matchups for albums that become unrated (moved to listed, or removed from their year) are unspecified. Say whether the replay skips them and what "remove" deletes.
5. The decade list rule "album's year entry falls in that decade" is only enforced at insert. Say what happens when the album moves decade, becomes listed or is removed. Line about eligible albums and the data model rule disagree.
6. "One album, one year" has no import rule for two different sheet rows that match the same album.
7. The rank-plus-honorable-mention row goes "on the review list", but a review item is only a catalog-match question, and the summary has no slot for it. Pick one mechanism.

**Minor**
8. "Why it fixes" overclaims the year-size bias; qualify it. 9. "Album count" should say rated albums only. 10. Listed albums have no rating to show. 11. The "about 674" explanation is off by a few. 12. Re-run safety has no identity key.

Verdict: CHANGES NEEDED

## Code review (pass 2)

Head: fdca942. Pass 1 items 1 to 5, 7 to 11 resolved. Remaining:

1. Import conflicts had no resolution on the review page; the summary mixed two meanings of "conflict"; the re-run key was not stored anywhere; the #10 follow-up line did not mention them.
2. Proof cited approval of an earlier version without noting the review amendments.

Verdict: CHANGES NEEDED

## Code review (pass 3)

Head: 5299178. Pass 2 findings resolved. New: acceptance 1 did not cover rows the user skips on the review page, and the #4 follow-up omitted the source row key and review item statuses.

Verdict: CHANGES NEEDED

## Code review (pass 4)

Head: 42e9abb. Pass 3 findings resolved (acceptance 1 now covers rows skipped on the review page; the #4 follow-up lists review item statuses and the source row key). No new contradictions.

Verdict: PASS

## Security review (pass 1)

Skipped: docs-only diff. review-scope: docs-only at 42e9abb9d4060ab007f92b2cf6564a2cb734090a: 1 files

Verdict: PASS

## Docs check

DOCS CHECK 42e9abb (origin/main...HEAD): one finding, rejected.
Docs checked: nothing stale at 42e9abb
Rejected: AGENTS.md does not exist, though project.md lists it as a living doc. Creating it, or changing project.md's docs list, is outside ALBUM-2 (a spec only); the scaffold ticket (#3) fills project.md and the app docs.
